tip.control: the UNDO button in the dive left rail
tip.text: Undo puts your junction back, but a trap it sprang stays sprung. Its drain is not refunded, so undo cannot probe for mines.

label.why: MECHANIC_INVENTORY has no row for oneUndo at all (the silent-gap class), so the tip above has nothing to attach to until this row exists. This label adds the bare row; the tip's own teaches array is what covers it, so no waiver is embedded in the row itself.

claims.text: a trap it sprang stays sprung
claims.resolves: takeUndo re-applies every trap the reverted move sprung and keeps the RAM drain on the player (drainNext += t.drain), so rolling the move back does not undo what the trap already cost.
